systems.system: Last Mile Connectivity for Rural Area and National Data Centre Project
systems.owner: Government of Malawi; financed by a US$56.9 million China Construction Bank loan authorised by Parliament on 25 January 2019
systems.tiers: fibre from the National Fibre Backbone connected from landing points to users by 136 planned towers in rural areas; first tower launched 13 June 2020, 28 towers in the current phase
national; landing points from which the last-mile towers extend

note: A loan record for rural towers and a data centre; no local government office is said to be connected, so the project is a backbone entry and gives no fact.
